# Krea

> Krea is an AI-powered creative suite for generating and editing images, videos, and 3D assets with multiple state-of-the-art generative models.

Krea provides both free and enterprise tools for creative professionals and teams, supporting text-to-image generation, video creation, upscaling, and enhancement with models like Flux, Veo 3.1, and Imagen. The platform offers API access for developers and seamless integration with creative workflows.

## Key Topics

- AI Image Generation
- AI Video Generation
- Image Upscaling
- Text-to-Image
- Flux
- Veo 3.1
- Super-Resolution
- Generative AI
- LoRA Fine-tuning
- Batch Processing
- Creative Suite
- Style Customization
- 4K/8K Enhancement
- Video Editing
- Enterprise Collaboration

## Core Creative Tools

- [Krea: AI Creative Suite for Images, Video & 3D](https://www.krea.ai): Krea's main creative suite for generating and editing images, videos, and 3D assets
- [Free AI Image Generator: Text to Image Online | Krea](https://www.krea.ai/features/ai-image-generator): Krea's AI image generator with Flux, Imagen, and multiple model options
- [AI Video Generator: Create videos from text and images | Krea](https://www.krea.ai/features/ai-video-generator): Krea's AI video generator supporting Veo 3, Wan 2.5, and other models

## Image Enhancement & Upscaling

- [Free AI Image Upscaler: Upscale Photos Online | Krea](https://www.krea.ai/features/ai-upscaler): Krea's AI upscaler for 2x-16x image resolution enhancement and restoration
- [Free AI Image Enhancer: Upscale Photos Online | Krea](https://www.krea.ai/features/ai-enhancer): Krea's AI image enhancer for photo quality improvement and detail restoration

## API & Developer Integration

- [KREA API - AI Image Generation, Upscaling & Video API | krea.ai](https://www.krea.ai/features/api): KREA API documentation for image generation, upscaling, and video with 40+ models

## Enterprise & Teams

- [Krea Enterprise | AI Creative Platform for Teams](https://www.krea.ai/enterprise): Krea Enterprise plan with team collaboration, SSO, and admin controls
